Revision b6d5f114a056 · 25 legacy fields on 25 pathways · dispositions: measured-and-projected-mixed 2 · wrong-quantity 2 · unsupported-generic 11 · migrate-to-measurement 3 · ambiguous-normalisation 6 · verified-same-architecture 1 · actions: split 2 · migrated 5 · removed 18.

Policy (from the dispositions file):
- **power_density** — a legacy power_density stays only as a structured measurement — a measured value with a defined denominator and operating basis becomes a physical-scope datum, a source-defined projection with an explicit denominator and assumptions a model-scope datum, a projection without a reproducible basis is removed and kept in the audit note; a power in W with no normalisation is wrong-quantity and migrates to its actual quantity (electrical power), never called W/m²; after the sweep the field is no longer writable and any 'best recorded power density' is derived from structured physical measurements of matching units and bases (the pass-36 reply, findings 26–34)
